description: This file defines runtime environment types, utility functions for logging, output handling, and process termination tailored for a Node.js environment. It manages runtime I/O, including console logging, stdout writing, JSON output, and process exit, with handling for testing and error scenarios.

methods.name: function shouldEmitRuntimeLog(env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv = process.env): boolean { shouldEmitRuntimeLog
methods.description: Determines if runtime logs should be emitted based on environment variables.

methods.name: function shouldEmitRuntimeStdout(env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv = process.env): boolean { shouldEmitRuntimeStdout
methods.description: Determines if stdout should be written based on environment variables.

methods.name: function isPipeClosedError(err: unknown): boolean { isPipeClosedError
methods.description: Checks if an error is due to a closed pipe (EPIPE or EIO).

methods.name: function hasRuntimeOutputWriter( hasRuntimeOutputWriter
methods.description: Type guard to check if a runtime object has a writeStdout method.

methods.name: function writeStdout(value: string): void { writeStdout
methods.description: Writes a string to stdout if permitted, adding a newline if not present.

methods.name: function createRuntimeIo(): Pick<OutputRuntimeEnv, "log" | "error" | "writeStdout" | "writeJson"/ createRuntimeIo
methods.description: Creates an object implementing log, error, writeStdout, and writeJson methods for runtime I/O.

methods.name: export function createNonExitingRuntime(): OutputRuntimeEnv { createNonExitingRuntime
methods.description: Creates a runtime environment that does not terminate the process.

methods.name: export function writeRuntimeStdout(runtime: RuntimeEnv | OutputRuntimeEnv, value: string): void / writeRuntimeStdout
methods.description: Writes output to the runtime's stdout implementation or logs if not available.

methods.name: export function writeRuntimeJson( writeRuntimeJson
methods.description: Serializes an object to JSON and writes it to the runtime's stdout, or logs if stdout is not available.

ctags.name: maybeMockedLog
ctags.pattern: /^  const maybeMockedLog = console.log as unknown as { mock?: unknown };$/

ctags.name: writeRuntimeStdout
ctags.pattern: /^export function writeRuntimeStdout(runtime: RuntimeEnv | OutputRuntimeEnv, value: string): void /
